evals.prompt: We are renaming the event type lw.experiment.run_finished to lw.experiment.run_completed. Write a migration that updates the stored rows in event_log.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to rewrite the log first (record §9, Alex 2026-10-06). Declares .withUpcasts({ events: [{ from: { type: 'lw.experiment.run_finished' }, to: 'lw.experiment.run_completed' }] }) on the owning pipeline after .withEvents, with drain if jobs queued under a former pipeline's keys must reach the new lanes. Says the ledger step upcast:<pipeline>:<stored type> is derived, not written. Notes the rewrite step is not landed (@unimplemented in packages/eventing/specs/event-upcast.feature), so the upcast stays until it is, and any delete of originals is a contract step at the LTS floor. Routes the details to eventing-and-worker.

evals.prompt: This PR stops reading Project.legacyKey. Add the DROP COLUMN in the same PR so we don't forget it.
evals.expected_output: Does not ship the drop: a contract step waits until the LTS floor (packages/upgrade/releases/lts-floor.json) is at or above the release that stopped reading it, and carries `-- contract: retired in <release>` with that release at or below the floor; the scanner refuses a missing note (drop-without-retirement-note) or a release above the floor (retirement-note-above-floor). Marks the column `/// retired: unread since <release>` in schema.prisma, leaves the drop out and names it in the handoff. Never moves the floor.

evals.prompt: I added a Prisma migration. The api now refuses to start saying a blocking step is not done. Can I make the api run pending migrations on boot so dev is easier?
evals.expected_output: No: api and worker never migrate (record §7, ADR-173); the serving gate refuses by name until `upgrade` has run. Apply with `pnpm start:prepare:db` (upgrade, then the system-migrations pass), not `pnpm prisma:migrate` or `pnpm clickhouse:migrate`, which bypass the ledger so the gate keeps refusing. Points to `pnpm task upgrade status` to see what is outstanding.

evals.prompt: Backfill the new Organization.billingCountry column from Stripe for existing organizations. Put it in the Prisma migration as an UPDATE.
evals.expected_output: Inline DML is only for small, SQL-only fixes inside one module's tables; a backfill that needs an external service or a peer *Api is a defineMigrationStep in the owning module's .withMigrations, kind data, mode background, run on the worker. Writers must set the new column from the release that adds it, because a fresh install plans data steps by mode and a step is never the only way a row becomes correct. Routes the recipe to migration-data-step and the column to postgres-migration (nullable or DEFAULT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS).
